description: This file provides a utility function `safeJsonStringify` that serializes JavaScript values into JSON strings with special handling for certain data types, such as bigint, functions, Errors, and Uint8Array. It aims to produce JSON representations that preserve important information and handle errors gracefully.

methods.name: export function safeJsonStringify(value: unknown): string | null { safeJsonStringify
methods.description: Serializes a value into a JSON string with custom handling for special data types, returning null if serialization fails.
